title: Todoist might be trying to send me away to another app
body:
We lost granular control on what time a task is due. Now we can only select times in increments of 5 minutes. While I understand that sliding by 60 numbers is an issue, iOS allows to press the numbers and a keyboard pops up to write a different time. Todoist doesn’t allow to hit the check to save the new time if it isn’t of a 5 minute increment. Using the natural language feature works, but it also destroys recurrence. 

So, the price increased, we lose functionality and now paid features are limited by your OS of choice. WearOS has Ramble, but not WatchOS. Apparently Android users are more important than us. If that’s the case it’s time for me to leave and let them keep the Android users.

title: Premium but not for long
body: Yep...I’ve been a premium in the past few years but starting to feel it’s not worth. Ticktick is a way younger app/company and already as introduced features that Todoist announced they would be doing for months and months. Calendars,boards, real usable app space, better widgets...the list goes on. Is it reliable? Yes really good, but if you’re trusting your productivity in a new app...I would not trust todoist any longer,others seem to be much worried to bring you more and better. For those already in the todoist workflow...start looking around just to try something different and you know what I mean.
